tests.why: threshold brake → balance, lock, decel diff

turns.note: 10 possible turns seen on a minority of laps — keep lapping to confirm or drop them · C2 often split into several detections (taken inconsistently)

2866|2|4|800.text: Launch wheelspin on the rears: accel diff lock down / taller 1st, or squeeze the throttle.
2866|2|4|800.evidence: median peak rear slip 17.97; 4/4 launches spun

2866|2|4|800.text: AWD fronts spinning at launch: center split more rearward / front accel diff down.
2866|2|4|800.evidence: median peak front slip 17.41; 4/4 launches

2866|2|4|800.text: Mid-corner understeer: front ARB -2 clicks or front springs softer (mech balance up); if only in fast corners, aero balance forward instead.
2866|2|4|800.evidence: USI median +0.206 over 24 corners (13 understeer, 0 mid-corner front reds)

2866|2|4|800.text: Fronts saturate under braking before turn-in: brake pressure DOWN toward the knee, then balance 2-3% rearward.
2866|2|4|800.evidence: 19/24 corners red on the fronts in phase 1

2866|2|4|800.text: Suspension hits full compression at speed: ride height up a notch or springs stiffer (verify on the HUD Suspension page).
2866|2|4|800.evidence: 56 bottoming frames above 40 mph (detector still coarse)

2866|2|4|800.text: Balance varies corner to corner (USI spread 0.55) — likely speed-dependent (mechanical vs aero). Split the verdict by corner speed before tuning.
2866|2|4|800.evidence: by type: hairpin +0.80 (n=5), medium +0.42 (n=8), fast +0.02 (n=11)

2866|2|4|800.text: Brake-lock pattern inconsistent across 16 stops (0 both-axle, 4 front-first, 0 rear-first) — more hard stops from 80+ mph before touching balance.
2866|2|4|800.evidence: deficit medians F 0.17 / R 0.08
